Noise-cancelling headphone comparison notes:
1. Sony WH-1000XM5 ($349 on sale): 30 hours battery life with ANC on, superior call microphone with 4 beamforming mics, fold-flat case but headband doesn't collapse.
2. Bose QuietComfort Ultra ($299 renewed): 24 hours battery life, most comfortable clamp force for glasses wearers, slightly better low-frequency transit rumble suppression.
3. Apple AirPods Max ($549): 20 hours battery, heaviest at 384g, seamless Mac/iPhone switching via H1 chips, lightning charging port is outdated.
Decision: Bose QC Ultra for commuter comfort.
